create_docling_parse_v2_backend: create a DoclingParseV2DocumentBackend to load and parse a PDF document using docling-parse v2
load_pdf_page: load a specific page from a PDF document and return a DoclingParseV2PageBackend instance
compute_text_cells: compute text cells with bounding box coordinates from parsed docling-parse v2 page data
get_text_in_rect: extract text from a PDF page within a given bounding box region
get_segmented_page: get a SegmentedPdfPage with textline cells from a parsed PDF page
